style: Anime illustration, clean confident ink linework, flat cel shading with soft painted highlights, warm paper-lantern light from one side, deep indigo night background with blurred orange lantern bokeh. Half-body portrait, facing the viewer, centered, head and shoulders fully in frame with space above the head. Original character design. No text, no letters, no watermark.
